text: Delivered in merge 527a1dd (branch commits a8efba7, 4e835ca) on top of Codex's handoff 0dff470. fs2/StudyExecution.scala: deterministic StudyRunId; StudySegment with sound SegmentTotal bounds (Exact for estimation, AtMost candidates*(2+cells)+focal+reference for bounded comparison, Unknown for reduction, AtMost(focal) for contrast); StudyOutcome Completed|Cancelled|Failed with a single Deferred commit point; events pull stream and start Resource-backed fiber with coalescing progress, cancellation only between uncancelable steps, defects captured with catchNonFatal. StudyExecutionSuite 12 tests under TestControl on JVM and JS covering cancel before/during/before-commit, stage order, ids, totals incl. fully-matched and no-reference fixtures, slow/detached/disposed observers, exactly-once settlement, completion at three quanta equal to plan.run incl. provenance, defect surfacing. Fresh-context review: merge after fixes, all applied. Verified on merged main: root 2,684 (clean build, Scala 3.7.4), consumer 16+16, boundaries clean. Left for X5/X6: recording/temporal composition, run-level total, responsiveness measurement.
